description: Narayana's cow sequence at n, counting from 1. The first three terms are 1, and each later term is the previous term plus the term three back. a(4) is 2, a(6) is 4, a(11) is 28, and a(15) is 129. n runs from 1 to 60. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/narayana-cows
